verses.sanskrit: तथा प्रतिसमादिष्टः कालिङ्गो वाहिनीपतिः ।  कथमद्भुतकर्माणं भीमसेनं महाबलम् ॥१॥
verses.english: Dhritarashtra said How did the Kalinga king, that commander of a large army, having been asked by my son and supported by his troops, fight in battle with that doer of wonderful deeds, the mighty Bhimasena, that hero who roved over the field of battle with his club?

verses.sanskrit: चरन्तं गदया वीरं दण्डहस्तमिवान्तकम् ।  योधयामास समरे कालिङ्गः सह सेनया ॥२॥
पुत्रेण तव राजेन्द्र स तथोक्तो महाबलः ।  महत्या सेनया गुप्तः प्रायाद्भीमरथं प्रति ॥३॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said O great king, thus asked by your son the mighty Kalinga king accompanied by large army, advanced towards the chariot of Bhima.

verses.sanskrit: तामापतन्तीं महतीं कलिङ्गानां महाचमूम् ।  रथाश्वनागकलिलां प्रगृहीतमहायुधाम् ॥४॥
verses.english: Odescendant of Bharata, Bhimasena, then supported by the Chedis, rushed towards that large and mighty Kalinga army consisting of many cars, horses, and elephants. It was armed with great weapons. It was advancing towards him with Ketumat, the son of the Nishada king, at its head.

verses.sanskrit: भीमसेनः कलिङ्गानामार्च्छद्भारत वाहिनीम् ।  केतुमन्तं च नैषादिमायान्तं सह चेदिभिः ॥५॥
ततः श्रुतायुः संक्रुद्धो राज्ञा केतुमता सह ।  आससाद रणे भीमं व्यूढानीकेषु चेदिषु ॥६॥
verses.english: Inflamed in anger, Shrutayu, clad in armour, followed by his troops in battle array and accompanied by king Ketumat, came in front of Bhima.

verses.sanskrit: रथैरनेकसाहस्रैः कलिङ्गानां नराधिप ।  अयुतेन गजानां च निषादैः सह केतुमान् ॥७॥
verses.english: The Kalinga king with many thousands cars, and Ketumat with ten thousand elephants and also the Nishadas.

verses.sanskrit: भीमसेनं रणे राजन् समन्तात् पर्यवारयत् ।  चेदिमत्स्यकरूषाश्च भीमसेनपदानुगाः ॥८॥
verses.english: All, O king, surrounded Bhimasena on all sides. Then the Chedis, the Matsyas, and the Karushas with Bhimasena at their head,

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यधावन्त समरे निषादान् सह राजभिः ।  ततः प्रववृते युद्धं घोररूपं भयावहम् ॥९॥
verses.english: And with many other kings, rushed with great force against the Nishadas. Then took place a fearful and terrible battle.

verses.sanskrit: न प्राजानन्त योधाः स्वान् परस्परजिघांसया ।  घोरमासीत्ततो युद्धं भीमस्य सहसा परैः ॥१०॥
verses.english: Between the warriors of booth the sides, all rushing forward with the desire to kill one another. Fearful was the battle that was fought between Bhima and his adversaries.

verses.sanskrit: यथेन्द्रस्य महाराज महत्या दैत्यसेनया ।  तस्य सैन्यस्य सङ्ग्रामे युध्यमानस्य भारत ॥११॥
verses.english: O great king, it resembled the battle that was fought between Indra and the great host of the Danavas. O descendant of Bharata, loud uproar rose from that mighty army fighting in that battle. It resembled the sound of the roaring ocean. O king, they cut down one another and made the whole field resemble a crematorium strewn with flesh and blood. Impelled by the desire to kill, they could not distinguish friends from foes.

verses.sanskrit: बभूव सुमहान् शब्दः सागरस्येव गर्जतः ।  अन्योन्यं स्म तदा योधा विकर्षन्तो विशांपते ॥१२॥
महीं चक्रुश्चितां सर्वां शशलोहितसन्निभाम् ।  योधांश्च स्वान् परान्वापि नाभ्यजानन् जिघांसया ॥१३॥
स्वानप्याददते स्वाश्च शूराः परमदुर्जयाः ।  विमर्दः सुमहानासीदल्पानां बहुभिः सह ॥१४॥
verses.english: Those brave warriors who were incapable of being easily defeated, cut down even their own friends. Fierce was the struggle that took place between the few and the many.

verses.sanskrit: कलिङ्गैः सह चेदीनां निषादैश्च विशांपते ।  कृत्वा पुरुषकारं तु यथाशक्ति महाबलाः ॥१५॥
verses.english: Between the Chedis and the Kalingas with the Nishadas, Displaying their prowess to the best of their power, the powerful.

verses.sanskrit: भीमसेनं परित्यज्य संन्यवर्तन्त चेदयः ।  सर्वैः कलिङ्गैरासन्नः सन्निवृत्तेषु चेदिषु ॥१६॥
verses.english: Chedis abandoned Bhimasena and turned back. When the Chedis turned back, that son of Pandu, Bhimsena met all the Kalingas. He did not turn back depending on the strength of his own arms. The greatly powerful Bhimasena did not move; from his car.

verses.sanskrit: स्वबाहुबलमास्थाय संन्यवर्तत पाण्डवः ।  न चचाल रथोपस्थाद्भीमसेनो महाबलः ॥१७॥
शितैरवाकिरद्बाणैः कलिङ्गानां वरूथिनीम् ।  कालिङ्गस्तु महेष्वासः पुत्रश्चास्य महारथः ॥१८॥
verses.english: He covered the Kalingas with showers of sharp arrows. Then that great bowman, the Kalinga king and that car-warriors, his son.

verses.sanskrit: शक्रदेव इति ख्यातो जघ्नतुः पाण्डवं शरैः ।  ततो भीमो महाबाहुर्विधुन्वन् रुचिरं धनुः ॥१९॥
verses.english: Named Shakradeva, both attacked the Pandava (Bhima) with ten arrows. But shaking his beautiful bow. the mighty armed Bhimasena.

verses.sanskrit: योधयामास कालिङ्गं स्वबाहुबलमाश्रितः ।  शक्रदेवस्तु समरे विसृजन् सायकान् बहून् ॥२०॥
verses.english: Fought with the Kalinga king, depending only on his own prowess of arms. Shakradeva shot innumerable arrows in that battle.

verses.sanskrit: अश्वान् जघान समरे भीमसेनस्य सायकैः ।  तं दृष्ट्वा विरथं तत्र भीमसेनमरिन्दमम् ॥२१॥
verses.english: And killed Bhimasena's horses with them. Seeing that chastiser of foes deprived of his car.

verses.sanskrit: शक्रदेवोऽभिदुद्राव शरैरवकिरन् शितैः ।  भीमस्योपरि राजेन्द्र शक्रदेवो महाबलः ॥२२॥
verses.english: Shakradeva rushed upon him; and shot many sharp arrows, O great king, on Bhimasena; the mighty Shakradeva poured a shower of arrows as clouds pour rain after the summer is gone.

verses.sanskrit: ववर्ष शरवर्षाणि तपान्ते जलदो यथा ।  हताश्वे तु रथे तिष्ठन् भीमसेनो महाबलः ॥२३॥
शक्रदेवाय चिक्षेप सर्वशैक्यायसीं गदाम् ।  स तया निहतो राजन् कालिङ्गतनयो रथात् ॥२४॥
verses.english: But the greatly strong Bhima stayed on that car, the horses of which had been killed. He hurled from it at Shakradeva a mace made of the hardest iron.

verses.sanskrit: विरथः सह सुतेन जगाम धरणीतलम् ।  हतमात्मसुतं दृष्ट्वा कलिङ्गानां जनाधिपः ॥२५॥
verses.english: Killed by that fearful mace, O king, the son of the Kalinga king fell down with his standard and charioteer.

verses.sanskrit: रथैरनेकसाहस्त्रैर्भीमस्यावारयद्दिशः ।  ततो भीमो महावेगां त्यक्त्वा गुर्वीं महागदाम् ॥२६॥
verses.english: Then that great car-warrior the Kalinga king, seeing his son killed. Surrounded Bhima on all sides with innumerable troops, then the greatly strong and mighty armed Bhima took up a sword with the desire of performing a great feat. O king, that foremost of men also took up a matchless shield made of the hide of a bull.

verses.sanskrit: निस्त्रिंशमाददे घोरं चिकीर्षुः कर्म दारुणम् ।  चर्म चाप्रतिमं राजन्नार्षभं पुरुषर्षभ ॥२७॥
नक्षत्रैरर्धचन्द्रैश्च शातकुम्भमयैश्चितम् ।  कालिङ्गस्तु ततः क्रुद्धो धनुर्ज्यामवमृज्य च ॥२८॥
verses.english: It was adorned with stars and crescents made of gold. The Kalinga king also in great anger rubbed his bow string and took up a poisoned Shakti. He shot it at Bhimasena with the desire of killing him.

verses.sanskrit: प्रगृह्य च शरं घोरमेकं सर्पविषोपमम् ।  प्राहिणोद्भीमसेनाय वधाकांक्षी जनेश्वरः ॥२९॥
तमापतन्तं वेगेन प्रेरितं निशितं शरम् ।  भीमसेनो द्विधा राजंश्चिच्छेद विपुलासिना ॥३०॥
verses.english: O king, Bhimsena however soon with his big sword cut down that sharp arrow which was rushing towards him with great impetuosity.

verses.sanskrit: उदक्रोशच्च संहृष्टस्त्रासयानो वरूथिनीम् ।  कालिङ्गोऽथ ततः क्रुद्धो भीमसेनाय संयुगे ॥३१॥
verses.english: He then a great delight sent up a loud shout which filed the troops with terror. The Kalinga king, being very much enraged in fighting with Bhimasena.

verses.sanskrit: तोमरान् प्राहिणोच्छीघ्रं चतुर्दश शिलाशितान् ।  तानप्राप्तान् महाबाहुः खगतानेव पाण्डवः ॥३२॥
verses.english: Soon hurled upon his fourteen darts with heads made of stone. The mighty armed Pandava (Bhima) soon cut them down into many fragments, O king, before they could reach him. Having cut down in that battle those fourteen arrows Bhima,

verses.sanskrit: चिच्छेद सहसा राजन्नसंभ्रान्तो वरासिना ।  निकृत्य तु रणे भीमस्तोमरान्वै चतुर्दश ॥३३॥
भानुन्मतं ततो भीमः प्राद्रवत्पुरुषर्षभः ।  भानुमांस्तु ततो भीमं शरवर्षेण च्छादयन् ॥३४॥
verses.english: That foremost of men, on seeing Bhanumat rushed upon him. Bhanumat thereupon covered Bhima with a shower of arrows. He set up a loud shout making the sky resound with it. Bhima however could not bear that lion-like shout in that battle.

verses.sanskrit: ननाद बलवन्नादं नादयानो नभस्तलम् ।  न च तं ममृषे भीमः सिंहनादं महाहवे ॥३५॥
ततः शब्देन महता विननाद महास्वनः ।  तेन नादेन वित्रस्ता कलिंगानां वरूथिनी ॥३६॥
verses.english: Possessing as he does a fearfully loud voice, he also sent up a very loud shout. At his fearful shouts, the Kalingas were filled with great alarm.

verses.sanskrit: न भीमं समरे मेने मानुषं भरतर्षभ ।  ततो भीमो महाबाहुर्नर्दित्वा विपुलं खनम् ॥३७॥
verses.english: O best of men, they no longer considered Bhima as a human being. O king of kings, then setting up a loud shout, Bhima.

verses.sanskrit: सासिर्वेगवदाप्लुत्य दन्ताभ्यां वारणोत्तमम् ।  आरुरोह ततो मध्यं नागराजस्य मारिष ॥३८॥
verses.english: With a sword in his hand, jumped upon the excellent elephant (of Bhanumat); and with the help of the tusk of that great elephant, he got on its back. Then with his huge sword, he cut down Bhanumat in two distinct parts. Having killed the Kalinga prince, that chastiser of foes,

verses.sanskrit: ततो मुमोच कालिङ्गः शक्तिं तामकरोद्द्विधा ।  खड्गेन पृथुना मध्ये भानुमन्तमथाच्छिनत् ॥३९॥
सोऽन्तरायुधिनं हत्वा राजपुत्रमरिन्दमः ।  गुरुं भारसहं स्कन्धे नागस्यासिमपातयत् ॥४०॥
verses.english: made his huge sword, which was capable of bearing a great strain, descend on the neck of the elephant. His head thus cut off, that great elephant fell with a tremendous roar,

verses.sanskrit: छिन्नस्कन्धः स विनदन् पपात गजयूथपः ।  आरुग्णः सिन्धुवेगेन सानुमानिव पर्वतः ॥४१॥
verses.english: As a mountain peak falls when eaten up by (the waves of the) sea. O descendant of Bharata, jumping down from that falling elephant, that descendant of Bharata.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तस्मादवप्लुत्य गजाद्भारत भारतः ।  खड्गपाणिरदीनात्मा तस्थौ भूमौ सुदंशितः ॥४२॥
स चचार बहून्मार्गानभितः पातयन् गजान् ।  अग्निचक्रमिवाविद्धं सर्वतः प्रत्यदृश्यत ॥४३॥
verses.english: Clad in armour, stood on the ground with his sword in his hand. Cutting down many elephants on all sides, he roved about making his way (through the troops of the enemy). He appeared to be like a moving wheel of fire. He slaughtered innumerable horsemen, elephants and car-warriors and foot soldiers. That foremost of men, the mighty Bhima was seen to move about the field with the speed of the hawk, cutting off with his sharp sword the bodies and heads of countless men (on foot) and also of those who were on elephant.

verses.sanskrit: अश्ववृन्देषु नागेषु रथानीकेषु चाभिभूः ।  पदातीनां च संधेषु विनिघ्नन् शोणितोक्षितः ॥४४॥
श्येनवद्व्यचरद्भीमो रणेऽरिषु बलोत्कटः ।  छिन्दंस्तेषां शरीराणि शिरांसि च महाबलः ॥४५॥
खड्गेन शितधारेण संयुगे गजयोधिनाम् ।  पदातिरेकः संक्रुद्धः शत्रूणां भयवर्धनः ॥४६॥
संमोहयामास स तान् कालान्तकयमोपमः ।  मूढाश्च ते तमेवाजौ विनदन्तः समाद्रवन् ॥४७॥
verses.english: Thus fighting on foot in great rage like Yama himself at the universal dissolution, he struck terror into the hearts of his enemies. Those brave warriors all became confounded.

verses.sanskrit: सासिमुत्तमवेगेन विचरन्तं महारणे ।  निकृत्य रथिनां चाजौ रथेषाश्च युगानि च ॥४८॥
verses.english: Only those that were foolish came rushing at him who was roving about that field of battle with sword in his hand.

verses.sanskrit: जघान रथिनश्चापि बलवान् रिपुमर्दनः ।  भीमसेनश्चरन् मार्गान् सुबहून् प्रत्यदृश्यत ॥४९॥
verses.english: That mighty chastiser of foes, cut off the shafts and yokes of those warriors on their cars, and he then killed them.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रान्तमाविद्धमुद्भ्रान्तमाप्लुतं प्रसृतं प्लुतम् ।  संपातं समुदीर्णं च दर्शयामास पाण्डवः ॥५०॥
verses.english: O descendant of Bharata, Bhimasena was seen to display various kinds of motions. He wheeled about and whirled about on high. He made side-thrusts, jumped forward, ran above and leapt high.

verses.sanskrit: केचिदग्रासिना छिन्नाः पाण्डवेन महात्मना ।  विनेदुर्भिन्नमर्माणो निपेतुश्च गतासवः ॥५१॥
verses.bhavadeepa: भ्रान्तमित्यादि भ्रान्तं मण्डलाकृति तदेव क्लमोपेतमाविद्धं भ्रान्तमेवोन्नतिसहितमुद्भ्रान्तम् आप्लुतं केवलमुत्प्लवनं प्रसृतं सर्वासु दिक्षु प्रसरणं प्लुतमेकस्यां दिशि सम्पातं वेगं समुदीर्णं सर्वान् प्रति समुद्यमम्॥५०॥

verses.sanskrit: छिन्नदन्ताग्रहस्ताश्च भिन्नकुंभास्तथा परे ।  वियोधाः स्वान्यनीकानि जघ्नुर्भारत वारणाः ॥५२॥
verses.english: Shrieked aloud; some mortally wounded, fell down and was killed. O descendant of Bharata, many elephants some with their trunks and the tusks cut off, others with their temporal globes cut open, fell down uttering fearful cries.

verses.sanskrit: निपेतुरुर्व्यां च तथा विनदन्तो महारवान् ।  छिन्नांश्च तोमरान् राजन् महामात्रशिरांसि च ॥५३॥
परिस्तोमान्विचित्रांश्च कक्ष्याश्च कनकोज्ज्वलाः ।  ग्रैवेयाण्यथ शक्तीश्च पताकाः कणपांस्तथा ॥५४॥
verses.english: O king, broken lances, heads of elephantsdrivers, beautiful housing of elephants, chords as shining as gold, collars darts, mallets, quivers, various kinds of machines, beautiful bows, short arrows with polished heads, hooks and screws various sorts of bells and belts decked with gold, these were seen falling or already fallen on the field of battle. With elephants having the fore parts and hind parts of their bodies and trunks cut off or entirely killed, the battle field appeared to be strewn with fallen cliffs.

verses.sanskrit: तूणीरानथ यन्त्राणि विचित्राणि धनूंषि च ।  भिन्दिपालानि शुभ्राणि तोत्राणि चाङ्कुशैः सह ॥५५॥
घण्टाश्च विविधा राजन् हेमगर्भान्त्सरूनपि ।  पततः पातितांश्चैव पश्यामः सह सादिभिः ॥५६॥
छिन्नगात्रावरकरैर्निहतैश्चापि वारणैः ।  आसीद्भूमिः समास्तीर्णा पतितैर्भूधरैरिव ॥५७॥
विमृद्यैवं महानागान् ममर्दान्यान्महाबलः ।  अश्वारोहवरांश्चैव पातयामास संयुगे ॥५८॥
verses.english: Having thus killed many huge elephants that foremost of men then began to destroy the horses. O descendant of Bharata, that hero felled many foremost of horse-men.
verses.bhavadeepa: गात्रावरैर्गात्रैः पूर्वकायैः अवरोधः कायैः । ‘द्वौ पूर्वपश्चाज्जङ्घादिदेशौ गात्रावरौ क्रमात्’ इति कोशः ॥५७॥

verses.sanskrit: तद्धोरमभवयुद्धं तस्य तेषां च भारत ।  खलीनान्यथ योक्त्राणि कक्ष्याश्च कनकोज्ज्वलाः ॥५९॥
verses.english: O sire, that battle was fought between him and those soldiers was exceedingly fearful. Hilts, traces, golden saddles girths, covers for the horses, bearded darts costly swords, armours, shields, and beautiful ornaments, were seen by us strewn over the ground in that great battle.

verses.sanskrit: परिस्तोमाश्च प्रासाश्च ऋष्टयश्च महाधनाः ।  कवचान्यथ चर्माणि चित्राण्यास्तरणानि च ॥६०॥
verses.bhavadeepa: खलीनानि अश्वस्य निवेश्यानि ‘कडिआळी’ इति प्रसिद्धानि । कक्ष्या गजमध्यबन्धनम् ॥५९॥

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तत्रापविद्धानि व्यदृश्यन्त महाहवे ।  प्रासैर्यंत्रैर्विचित्रैश्च शस्त्रैश्च विमलैस्तथा ॥६१॥
स चक्रे वसुधां कीर्णां शबलैः कुसुमैरिव ।  आप्लुत्य रथिनः कांश्चित्परामृश्य महाबलः ॥६२॥
verses.english: He caused the earth to be covered with blood, thus making her look as if she were variegated with lilies. The might Pandava, jumping high and dragging down some carwarriors, cut them down with their standards.

verses.sanskrit: पातयामास खड्गेन सध्वजानपि पाण्डवः ।  मुहुरुत्पततो दिक्षु धावतश्च यशस्विनः ॥६३॥
मार्गांश्च चरतश्चित्रं व्यस्मयन्त रणे जनाः ।  स जघान पदा कांश्चिद्व्याक्षिप्यान्यानपोथयत् ॥६४॥
verses.english: Often jumping up and frequently rushing on all sides, that greatly powerful hero roved about and filled all the troops with wonder. Some he killed by his legs, some he dragged down and pressed them into the earth,

verses.sanskrit: खड्गेनान्यांश्च चिच्छेद नादेनान्यांश्च भीषयन् ।  ऊरुवेगेन चाप्यन्यान् पातयामास भूतले ॥६५॥
verses.english: Others he cut down with his sword, others again he frightened with his terrible roars. Others he threw down by the force of his thighs.

verses.sanskrit: अपरे चैनमालोक्य भयात् पञ्चत्वमागताः ।  एवं सा बहुला सेना कलिङ्गानां तरस्विनाम् ॥६६॥
verses.english: Others again fled away on simply seeing him. It was thus that the great and powerful army of the Kalingas surrounded Bhimasena and rushed upon him. O best of the Bharata race, seeing, the Shrutayu at the head of the Kalinga troops, Bhimasena rushed at him. Seeing Shrutayu at the head of the Kalinga troops Bhimsena rushed at him. Seeing him come, the Kalinga king wounded Bhimasena with nine arrows. Wounded by those arrows shot by the Kalinga king, like an elephant pierced by the hook.

verses.sanskrit: परिवार्य रणे भीष्मं भीमसेनमुपाद्रवत् ।  ततः कालिङ्गसैन्यानां प्रमुखे भरतर्षभ ॥६७॥
श्रुतायुषमभिप्रेक्ष्य भीमसेनः समभ्ययात् ।  तमायान्तमभिप्रेक्ष्य कालिङ्गो नवभिः शरैः ॥६८॥
भीमसेनममेयात्मा प्रत्यविध्यत् स्तनान्तरे ।  कालिङ्गबाणाभिहतस्तोत्रार्दित इव द्विपः ॥६९॥
भीमसेनः प्रजज्वाल क्रोधेनाग्निरिवैधितः ।  अथाशोकः समादाय रथं हेमपरिष्कृतम् ॥७०॥
verses.english: Bhimsena blazed up in wrath like a fire fed with fuels. Then that best of charioteers, Ashoka, soon brought a car decked with gold, and he caused Bhima to mount upon it. Thereupon that chastiser of foes, the son of Kunti (Bhima) soon mounted on that car.

verses.sanskrit: भीमं संपादयामास रथेन रथसारथिः ।  तमारुह्य रथं तूर्णं कौन्तेयः शत्रुसूदनः ॥७१॥
कालिङ्गमभिदुद्राव तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत् ।  ततः श्रुतायुर्बलवान् भीमाय निशितान् शरान् ॥७२॥
verses.english: Then he rushed towards the Kalinga king, shouting “Wait” “Wait”. Then the greatly powerful Shrutayu, in great anger, shot at Bhima many sharp arrows and thus displayed his great lightness of hands. O king, thus wounded by those nine sharp arrows shot by the Kalinga king from his excellent bow, that great warrior Bhima blazed up in anger like a snake struck with a rod.

verses.sanskrit: प्रेषयामास संक्रुद्धो दर्शयन् पाणिलाघवम् ।  स कार्मुकवरोत्सृष्टैर्नवाभिर्निशितैः शरैः ॥७३॥
समाहतो महाराज कालिङ्गेन महात्मना ।  संचुक्रुशे भृशं भीमो दण्डाहत इवोरगः ॥७४॥
क्रुद्धश्च चापमायम्य बलवद्बलिनां वरः ।  कालिङ्गमवधीत्पार्थो भीमः सप्तभिरायसैः ॥७५॥
verses.english: Then that foremost of powerful men, that son of Pritha, Bhima in great anger drew his bow to its highest stretch, and killed the Kalinga king with seven iron arrows.

verses.sanskrit: क्षुराभ्यां चक्ररक्षौ च कालिंगस्य महाबलौ ।  सत्यदेवं च सत्यं च प्राहिणोद्यमसादनम् ॥७६॥
verses.english: With two arrows he killed the two powerful protectors of his car-wheels; he also killed Satyadeva and Satya.

verses.sanskrit: ततः पुनरमेयात्मा नाराचैर्निशितैस्त्रिभिः ।  केतुमन्तं रणे भीमोऽगमयद्यमसादनम् ॥७७॥
verses.english: Thereupon high-souled Bhima then with many sharp arrows caused the destruction of Ketumat.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कलिङ्गाः संन्नद्धा भीमसेनममर्षणम् ।  अनीकैर्बहुसाहस्त्रैः क्षत्रियाः समवारयन् ॥७८॥
verses.english: Thereupon the Kalinga warriors in great anger met the angry Bhimasena in battle backed by many thousands of combatants.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शक्तिगदाखड्गतोमरर्ष्टिपरश्वधैः ।  कलिङ्गाश्च ततो राजन् भीमसेनमवाकिरन् ॥७९॥
verses.english: O king, armed with darts and maces and swords and lances and scimitars and battleaxes, the Kalingas by hundreds and thousands surrounded Bhimasena.

verses.sanskrit: संनिवार्य स तां घोरां शरवृष्टिं समुत्थिताम् ।  गदामादाय तरसा संनिपत्य महाबलः ॥८०॥
verses.english: Resisting that shower of arrows, that great warrior (Bhima) then took up his fearful mace. He then jumped down from his car in great speed.

verses.sanskrit: भीमः सप्त शतान् वीराननयद्यमसादनम् ।  पुनश्चैव द्विसाहस्रान् कलिङ्गानरिमर्दनः ॥८१॥
verses.english: Bhima then killed seven hundred heroes; that chastiser of foes then sent two thousand Kalingas to the region of Death. It was a wonderful feat; it was thus that the heroic and the fearfully strong Bhima again and again killed in that battle a very large number of the Kalingas. Elephants were deprived of their riders by that son of Pandu. Afflicted with arrows they roved about the field, treading down innumerable troops and uttering roars like those of the clouds.

verses.sanskrit: प्राहिणोन्मृत्युलोकाय तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ।  एवं स तान्यनीकानि कलिङ्गानां पुनः पुनः ॥८२॥
बिभेद समरे तूर्णं प्रेक्ष्य भीष्मं महारथम् ।  हतारोहाश्च मातङ्गाः पाण्डवेन कृता रणे ॥८३॥
विप्रजग्मुरनीकेषु मेघा वातहता इव ।  मृद्नन्तः स्वान्यनीकानि विनदन्तः शरातुराः ॥८४॥
ततो भीमो महाबाहुः खड्गहस्तो महाभुजः ।  संप्रहृष्टो महाघोषं शङ्खं प्राध्मापयद्बली ॥८५॥
verses.english: Then the mighty-armed Bhima with his sword in his hand blew in great delight his fearfully roaring conch.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकालिङ्गसैन्यानां मनांसि समकंपयत् ।  मोहश्चापि कलिङ्गानामाविवेश परंतप ॥८६॥
verses.english: With that tremendous sound the hearts of the Kalinga troops began to tremble in fear. O chastiser of foes, the Kalingas appeared to have lost all consciousness.

verses.sanskrit: प्राकंपन्त च सैन्यानि वाहनानि च सर्वशः ।  भीमेन समरे राजन् गजेन्द्रेणेव सर्वशः ॥८७॥
verses.english: All the combatants and all the animals trembled in fear. By Bhimasena's roving about over the field of battle like an infuriated elephant, and by his frequent jumping up, a short of trance came over the foe. The whole Kalinga army trembled in fear like a large lake agitated by an alligator.

verses.sanskrit: मार्गान् बहून् विचरता धावता च ततस्ततः ।  मुहुरुत्पतता चैव संमोहः समपद्यत ॥८८॥
भीमसेनभयत्रस्तं सैन्यं च समकम्पत ।  क्षोभ्यमाणमसंबाधं ग्राहेणेव महत्सरः ॥८९॥
त्रासितेषु च सर्वेषु भीमेनाद्भुतकर्मणा ।  पुनरावर्तमानेषु विद्रवत्सु च सङ्घशः ॥९०॥
verses.english: Struck with panic, the Kalingas, fled away in all directions. When they were rallied again, the commander of the Pandava army (Dhrishtadyumna) then ordered his troops, exclaiming “fight”.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकालिङ्गयोधेषु पाण्डूनां ध्वजिनीपतिः ।  अब्रवीत्स्वान्यनीकानि युध्यध्वमिति पार्षतः ॥९१॥
सेनापतिवचः श्रुत्वा शिखण्डिप्रमुखा गणाः ।  भीममेवाभ्यवर्तन्त रथानीकैः प्रहारिभिः ॥९२॥
verses.english: Having heard the word of their commander, many heroes headed by Shikhandin came to the help of Bhima, supported by many wellskilled car-warriors.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मराजश्च तान् सर्वानुपजग्राह पाण्डवः ।  महता मेघवर्णेन नागानीकेन पृष्ठतः ॥९३॥
verses.english: The Pandava, king Yudhishthira Dharmaraja followed all of them behind with a large force of elephants, each of the colour of clouds.

verses.sanskrit: एवं संनोद्य सर्वाणि स्वान्यनीकानि पार्षतः ।  भीमसेनस्य जग्राह पार्ष्णिं सत्पुरुषैर्वृतः ॥९४॥
verses.english: Thus urging all his troops, the Prishata prince surrounded by many great warriors went to protect one of the wings of Bhima's troops.

verses.sanskrit: न हि पञ्चालराजस्य लोके कश्चन विद्यते ।  भीमसात्यकयोरन्यः प्राणेभ्यः प्रियकृत्तमः ॥९५॥
verses.english: To the Panchala prince, there was none dearer than life on earth except Satyaki and Bhima.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽपश्यच्च कलिङ्गेषु चरन्तमरिसूदनः ।  भीमसेनं महाबाहुं पार्षतः परवीरहा ॥९६॥
verses.english: That slayer of hostile heroes, the Prishata prince saw that chastiser of foes the mightyarmed Bhimasena fighting among the Kalingas.

verses.sanskrit: ननर्द बहुधा राजन् हृष्टश्चासीत् परंतपः ।  शङ्खं दध्मौ च समरे सिंहनादं ननाद च ॥९७॥
verses.english: O chastiser of foes, O king. He sent forth many loud shouts and filled all his troops with delight. He blew his conch and uttered a lion like roar.

verses.sanskrit: स च पारावताश्वस्य रथे हेमपरिष्कृते ।  कोविदारध्वजं दृष्ट्वा भीमसेनः समाश्वसत् ॥९८॥
verses.english: Seeing the red standard of Dhrishtadyumna's car decked with gold and yoked with milk white steeds, Bhimasena became much encouraged.

verses.sanskrit: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तु तं दृष्ट्वा कलिङ्गैः समभिद्रुतम् ।  भीमसेनममेयात्मा त्राणायाजौ समभ्ययात् ॥९९॥
verses.english: The high-souled, Dhrishtadyumna, seeing Bhimasena attacked by the innumerable Kalingas rushed to his rescue.
verses.bhavadeepa: पारावताश्वस्य मर्कटतिन्दुकसमानवर्णाश्वस्य । ‘पारावतः कलरवे शैले मर्कटतिन्दुके’ इति विश्वः ॥९८॥

verses.sanskrit: तौ दूरात् सात्यकिं दृष्ट्वा धृष्टद्युम्नवृकोदरौ ।  कलिङ्गान् समरे वीरौ योधयेतां मनस्विनौ ॥१००॥
verses.english: Seeing Satyaki at a distance, those two greatly powerful heroes Dhrishtadyumna and Vrikodara furiously fell upon the Kalingas.

verses.sanskrit: स तत्र गत्वा शैनेयो जवेन जयतां वरः ।  पार्थपार्षतयोः पार्ष्णिं जग्राह पुरुषर्षभः ॥१०१॥
verses.english: The foremost of men, the descendant of (Shini), that best of all warriors (Satyaki) also soon came to the spot and defended the wings of both Bhima and the Prishata prince.

verses.sanskrit: स कृत्वा दारुणं कर्म प्रगृहीतशरासनः ।  आस्थितो रौद्रमात्मानं कलिङ्गानन्ववैक्षत ॥१०२॥
verses.english: With his big bow in his hand, he created a great havoc. Making himself fierce in the extreme, he began to kill the enemy.

verses.sanskrit: कलिङ्गप्रभवां चैव मांसशोणितकर्दमाम् ।  रुधिरस्यन्दिनीं तत्र भीमः प्रावर्तयन्नदीम् ॥१०३॥
verses.english: Bhima caused a river of blood to flow, it was made of the flesh and blood of the Kalingas.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तरेण कलिङ्गानां पाण्डवानां च वाहिनीम् ।  तां सन्ततार दुस्तारां भीमसेनो महाबलः ॥१०४॥
verses.english: Bhimasena crossed the inaccessible blood river flowing between Kalinga and arıny of Pandavas by virtue of his unique valour.

verses.sanskrit: भीमसेनं तथा दृष्ट्वा प्राक्रोशंस्तावका नृप ।  कालोऽयं भीमरूपेण कलिङ्गैः सह युध्यते ॥१०५॥
verses.english: O king, seeing Bhima in this fearful fight, all the troops exclaimed, “This one who is fighting in Bhima's shape with the Kalingas is Yama himself".

verses.sanskrit: ततः शान्तनवो भीष्मः श्रुत्वा तं निनदं रणे ।  अभ्ययात्त्वरितो भीमं व्यूढानीकः समन्ततः ॥१०६॥
verses.english: Having heard their cries, the son of Shantanu, Bhishma, surrounded on all sides by many warriors, soon came to Bhima.

verses.sanskrit: तं सात्यकिर्भीमसेनो धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः ।  अभ्यद्रवन्त भीष्मस्य रथं हेमपरिष्कृतम् ॥१०७॥
verses.english: Thereupon Satyaki, Bhima, and the Prishata prince Dhrishtadyumna all rushed towards Bhishma's car decked with gold.

verses.sanskrit: परिवार्य तु ते सर्वे गाङ्गेयं तरसा रणे ।  त्रिभिस्त्रिभिः शरैर्घोरैर्भीष्ममानर्छुरोजसा ॥१०८॥
verses.english: All of them soon surrounded the son of Ganga. Without losing a moment they wounded Bhishma each with three fearful arrows.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यविध्यत तान् सर्वान् पिता देवव्रतस्तव ।  यतमानान् महेष्वासांस्त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरजिह्मगैः ॥१०९॥
ततः शरसहस्त्रेण सन्निवार्य महारथान् ।  हयान् काञ्चनसन्नाहान् भीमस्य न्यहनच्छरैः ॥११०॥
verses.english: Having checked those mighty car-warriors with thousands of arrows, he killed with his arrows the horses of Bhima clad in golden armour.

verses.sanskrit: हताश्वे स रथे तिष्ठन् भीमसेनः प्रतापवान् ।  शक्तिं चिक्षेप तरसा गाङ्गेयस्य रथं प्रति ॥१११॥
verses.english: The greatly strong Bhima however stood on the car, the horses of which were killed. He then with great force hurled a dart at Bhishma.

verses.sanskrit: अप्राप्तामथ तां शक्तिं पिता देवव्रतस्तव ।  त्रिधा चिच्छेद समरे सा पृथिव्यामशीर्यत ॥११२॥
verses.english: Your father Devavrata cut off in that battle that dart before it could reach his car. It then fell in fragments on the grounds.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शैक्यायसीं गुर्वीं प्रगृह्य बलवान् गदाम् ।  भीमसेनस्ततस्तूर्णं पुप्लुवे मनुजर्षभ ॥११३॥
verses.english: Then that foremost of men, Bhimasena took up a heavy and might mace made of Saikya iron. He then jumped down from his car.

verses.sanskrit: सात्यकोऽपि ततस्तूर्णं भीमस्य प्रियकाम्यया ।  गाङ्गेयसारथिं तूर्णं पातयामास सायकैः ॥११४॥
verses.english: Satyaki however, in order to do what is agreeable to Bhima, cut down with his arrows the charioteer of the revered Kuru grandfather.

verses.sanskrit: भीष्मस्तु निहते तस्मिन् सारथौ रथिनां वरः ।  वातायमानैस्तैरश्वैरपनीतो रणाजिरात् ॥११५॥
verses.english: When his charioteer was thus killed, that foremost of car-warriors Bhishma was borne away from the battle field by his horses which ran with the speed of wind.

verses.sanskrit: भीमसेनस्ततो राजन्नपयाते महाव्रते ।  प्रजज्वाल यथा वह्निर्दहन् कक्षमिवैधितः ॥११६॥
verses.english: O king, when that great car-warrior was thus carried away from the field of battle, Bhima blazed up like a great fire when it consumes dry grass.

verses.sanskrit: स हत्वा सर्वकालिङ्गान् सेनामध्ये व्यतिष्ठत ।  नैनमभ्युत्सहन् केचित्तावका भरतर्षभ ॥११७॥
verses.english: Having killed all the Kalingas, O best of the Bharata race, he stood in the midst of the troops, and none dared to withstand him.

verses.sanskrit: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तमारोप्य स्वरथे रथिनां वरः ।  पश्यतां सर्वसैन्यानामपोवाह यशस्विनम् ॥११८॥
verses.english: But Dhrishtadyumna soon took up that foremost of car warriors on his own car. He then took away that illustrious hero in the sight of all the warriors.

verses.sanskrit: संपूज्यमानः पाञ्चाल्यैर्मत्स्यैश्च भरतर्षभ ।  धृष्टद्युम्नं परिष्वज्य समेयादथ सात्यकिम् ॥११९॥
verses.english: O best of the Bharata race, praised by the Pandavas and the Matsyas, he embraced Dhrishtadyumna and then went to Satyaki.

verses.sanskrit: अथाब्रवीद्भीमसेनं सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः ।  प्रहर्षयन् यदुव्याघ्रो धृष्टद्युम्नस्य पश्यतः ॥१२०॥
verses.english: That foremost of the Yadus, that irresistible hero Satyaki then thus spoke to Bhimasena in the presence of Dhrishtadyumna.

verses.sanskrit: दिष्ट्या कलिङ्गराजश्च राजपुत्रश्च केतुमान् ।  शक्रदेवश्च कालिंगः कलिंगाश्च मृधे हताः ॥१२१॥
verses.english: By good luck the Kalinga king, also the Kalinga prince Ketumat and also Shakradeva of that country and also all the Kalingas have been killed, you in this battle.

verses.sanskrit: स्वबाहुबलवीर्येण नागाश्वरथसंकुलः ।  महापुरुषभूयिष्ठो धीरयोधनिषेवितः ॥१२२॥
verses.english: The army of the Kalingas, consisting of many thousands of cars, elephants, horses, noble warriors and heroic combatants, has been destroyed by your prowess of arm alone.

verses.sanskrit: महाव्यूहः कलिङ्गानामेकेन मृदितस्त्वया ।  एवमुक्त्वा शिनेर्नप्ता दीर्घबाहुररिन्द‌म ॥१२३॥
रथाद्रथमभिद्रुत्य पर्यष्वजत पाण्डवम् ।  ततः स्वरथमास्थाय पुनरेव महारथः ।  तावकानवधीत् क्रुद्धो भीमस्य बलमादधत् ॥१२४॥
verses.english: Having said this, the mighty-armed grandson of Shini the chastiser of foes embraced the son of Pandu (Bhima). He then quickly got upon his car. Then that great carwarrior began to kill the troops in anger, thus strengthening the hands of Bhima.
